segments.text: Hand massage is a great technique for improving your hand sensitivity to vibrations.
Our hands are like a map of our subtle system, so the more we are able to feel vibrations,
the better we can understand our internal state.
For this treatment, all you need is a little olive oil, as it is suitable for any constitution.
Sit comfortably for meditation, with your hands open in your lap, and bring your attention within.
Pay attention to your hands and observe what you are feeling there.
Is there any warmth, tingling, heaviness, or coolness, or maybe nothing at all?
How do the two hands differ from one another?
Just observe.
Pour a little olive oil into your hands and rub it all over.
We will massage each area of the hand, keeping our attention on the corresponding chakras
and asking our mother kundalini to cleanse them and awaken their qualities.
Start with your left hand, massaging the base of the palm with your right thumb in a clockwise direction.
This area is connected to our left Mooladhara.
Here we can ask within,
Mother, please cleanse my left Mooladhara chakra.
Please nourish my pure wisdom and innocence.
Next, hold your left thumb between your right index and middle fingers.
Pull gently and rotate in both directions.
Apply pressure to the sides of the nail, then hold the finger still and put all your attention in the left lower abdomen.
Here we can ask within, Mother Kundalini, please cleanse my left Swadhisthana chakra,
please nourish the pure knowledge within me.
Now massage your left middle finger in a similar fashion with your right index and middle fingers.
Now, hold your fingers still and put all of your attention in the left side of your stomach.
Mother Kundalini, please cleanse my left Nabhi chakra. Please make me feel satisfied.
Next, we can move on to the left pinky finger.
We are doing all the chakras in order as they appear in your subtle system.
Massage here in the same way, then hold the fingers still and put all your attention in the left of the chest where your heart is.
We can ask within, Mother Kundalini, please cleanse my left heart chakra, please connect me to my spirit.
Now massage your left index finger, then hold the finger still and put all your attention in the left of the neck.
Here we can say, Mother Kundalini, please cleanse my left Vishuddhi chakra, please remove all guilt from within me.
Next massage your left ring finger, then hold the finger still,
And put all your attention in the right side of the head.
Here we can say within, Mother Kundalini, please bring down my super ego.
Please remove all self-doubt and conditionings.
Finally, you can rotate the right thumb around the palm of the left hand a bit
and then massage the whole of the left hand.
We can ask within, Mother Kundalini, please nourish my whole left energy channel.
Now hold both of your hands out in your lap and take a moment to see how you are feeling compared to when you started.
Have the sensations in your hands changed at all?
The technique is then to be repeated for the right hand.
You can apply some more olive oil before beginning.
Start by massaging the base of your right palm with your left thumb in a clockwise direction.
This area is connected to our right Mooladhara.
Here we can ask within, Mother Kundalini,
Please cleanse my right Mooladhara chakra. Please protect me from all negative thoughts and emotions.
Next, hold your right thumb between your left index and middle fingers. Pull gently and rotate in both directions.
Apply a little pressure to the sides of the nail, then hold the finger still and put all your attention in the right lower abdomen.
Here we can ask within. Mother Kundalini,
Please cleanse my right Swadhisthana chakra. Please give me pure, stable attention.
Now massage your right middle finger in a similar fashion, using your left index and middle fingers.
Now hold your fingers still and put all of your attention in the right side of your stomach.
Here we can ask, Mother Kundalini, please cleanse my right Nabhi chakra. Please nourish the royal dignity in me.
Next, we can move on to the right pinky finger.
Massage here in the same way.
Then hold the finger still and put all your attention in the right of the chest.
We can ask within,
Mother Kundalini, please cleanse my right heart chakra.
Please awaken rightful conduct in me.
Now massage your right index finger.
Then hold the finger still and put all your attention on the right side of the neck.
Here we can say, Mother Kundalini,
Please cleanse my right Vishuddhi chakra. Please nourish sweet speech and behavior in me.
Next, massage your right ring finger, then hold the finger still and put all your attention on the left side of the head.
Here we can say within, Mother Kundalini, please bring down my ego. I forgive everyone and I forgive myself.
Finally, you can rotate the left thumb around the palm of the right hand a bit.
And then massage the whole right hand.
We can ask within,
Mother Kundalini, please nourish my whole right energy channel.
Please enlighten all my thoughts and actions.
To finish, you can again hold both of your hands open on your lap
and observe what you are feeling there.
Do you feel any coolness, any warmth or tingling?
Is it any different from when you started?
You may be feeling nothing at all, which is fine.
It's a process which goes at a different pace for everyone.
Now put your attention at the top of your head and remain in silence for as long as you wish to enjoy the state of meditation.
